scope: 通常版BinaryTrieの後、1次元動的Fenwick Treeの2周目速度比較。rectangle専用改修は対象外。

environment.measurement: コア別lock・候補と同一baseline実行ファイルcontrolを乱択交互に実行。周波数は固定せず。

fixed_main: 初期配列を順にaddし、照会を入力順にadd/sumして出力。main/共通I/Oは変更しない。

decision.layout: c+(c>>10)/c+(c>>12)でcache競合を避ける2案。固定main最大乱数5件で約5〜6%、random03で約11〜12%後退。不採用。
decision.prefetch: dense_addの先祖セル1段/2段をbuiltinで先読み。最大乱数で約1.2〜3.0%後退。標準fallback付きのprototypeのみ、不採用。
decision.SIMD: AVX2 gather2/4×32/64bit添字の4案。大規模randomの最良約2.3%改善に対しprefix約13.8%、単点約18.6%後退。N32768でも最良約38%後退。CPU判定費用なし・同等関数呼出費用の楽観的な孤立比較でも不足。不採用。
decision.cache: 完全占有dense配列の非所有ポインタを保持し、更新だけ/更新と照会のdispatchを省く2案。固定main最大乱数で約4〜5%後退。不採用。コピー/状態遷移のコードも実験版へ追加したが、34設定の完全検証を候補へ流用しない。
decision.production: 本体・公開API・使用例・Document・main/I/O・2D共有部品は変更しない。既存のSIMD実装を除去した意味ではなく、今回追加のSIMD案を採用しない。

correctness_scope: root cache2案、padding2案、prefetch2案の公式21件は各process出力が独立期待値と一致。gatherは独立prefix表に照合。全候補の全API正当性を確定したという意味ではない。

layout/summary.json.decision: reject both dense-padding candidates; production unchanged
layout/summary.json.method: Intel Core i9-14900K P-Core12; GCC15.2 -std=c++23 -O2 -march=native -DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS; fixed main/sharedIO; same-binary control; randomized interleaved variants,21 officialcases×7 rounds; each output matches official tokens
layout/summary.json.rationale: DirectReads=trueの密セルをc+(c>>10)またはc+(c>>12)へ写像。最大乱数5件で両案とも5〜6%後退、random03で約11〜12%後退。同一binary controlは大規模概ね±1%。safe gainなし。追加添字演算の費用が影響する可能性はあるが、因果をprofileで確定したものではない。
layout/summary.json.shared_guard_note: DirectReads=falseは添字写像をidentityにしている。ただしBPlus共有guardがあるため、採用時は2Dソースの共有定義も同期しないとinclude順で1Dが不整合になる。今回不採用につき無変更。

layout/prefetch-summary.json.decision: reject both update-prefetch candidates; production unchanged
layout/prefetch-summary.json.method: Intel Core i9-14900K P-Core12; GCC15.2 -std=c++23 -O2 -march=native -DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS; fixed main/sharedIO; 21 officialcases×5 rounds; randomized interleaved variants and byte-identical baseline control; each output matches officialtokens
layout/prefetch-summary.json.rationale: 完全占有denseの更新だけ1段/2段先の祖先セルへwrite-prefetch。最大乱数5件ではprefetch1が1.9〜3.0%後退、prefetch2が1.2〜2.4%後退(control-0.5〜+0.6%)。random04も約3.1%/4.3%後退。明確な高速化なし。不採用。
layout/prefetch-summary.json.implementation_note: DirectReads=trueだけGCC/Clang builtinを使い、その他は従来の標準C++ループへプリプロセッサで戻す。SIMD実装は追加していない。

simd/gather-results.json.scope: Optimistic isolated SIMD helper test: all scalar/SIMD are noinline equal indirect-call overhead; no per-query CPU dispatch cost is charged, so scalar inlining in actual library could further favor scalar.

simd/gather32-results.json.scope: Optimistic isolated SIMD helper test: all scalar/SIMD are noinline equal indirect-call overhead; no per-query CPU dispatch cost is charged, so scalar inlining in actual library could further favor scalar.

simd/report.json.scope: 1D DynamicFenwickTree dense integer range/prefix fast path SIMD feasibility. No main/IO or library edits; isolated standard scalar operations copied from current CompactFenwick::sum(l,r).
simd/report.json.environment: Intel i9-14900K P-Core4; GCC15.2.0; -std=c++23 -O2 -march=native; per-core lock; 9 rounds randomized interleaved, same baseline function in same process as control. Frequency not fixed.
prototypes: AVX2 4x64bit index gather unroll2 + vector clear-lowbit twice
AVX2 4x32bit index gather unroll2 + vector clear-lowbit twice
simd/report.json.method: N32/1024/32768/500000; 262144 queries/condition; uniform endpoints/prefix/length1..32/single element. Expected aggregate computed from an independent original-array prefix table. All candidates matched every expected aggregate. SIMD CPU support checked once, no per-query dispatch cost charged. All variants use equal noinline indirect calls, making this an optimistic SIMD screen vs real inlined scalar library. Small N is a helper comparison, not the Tiny implementation.

findings.index64_N500000: uniform gather2 .994x, short .979x but prefix1.111x and singleton1.146x; gather4 uniform1.024x prefix1.040x singleton1.073x
findings.index32_N500000: uniform gather2 .977x but prefix1.138x and singleton1.186x; gather4 uniform1.014x prefix1.012x singleton1.058x
findings.control: All large-condition samebaseline controls within about1%. Fullraw included for checking clock drift.

simd/report.json.decision: Do not integrate: slight gains in memory-bound random conditions fail preservation of large prefix/single-point performance; smaller helper conditions are materially slower. Runtime dispatch/inlining losses would not repair this. No requirement to add unused SIMD, CPU dispatcher, config macro, source test, or standard fallback to production for a rejected prototype. This does not establish that every possible SIMD algorithm is ineffective.

limits: 全入力/CPU/コンパイラで最適と断定しない。旧58ms提出の時間は別版の結果。今回のローカル結果を新しいオンラインACへ書き換えない。
